content.summary: A tram inspector is verified from roof walk to harbor-scale aerial. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult identity and moving carrier remain fixed. + Background parallax continuously proves locomotion. + Camera scale changes do not interrupt the route. + The close portrait retains motion evidence. + The terminal aerial view reconnects person, carrier and geography.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult safety inspector with a silver braid, orange shell and black harness on the roof of a slow coastal tram. Orbit to a centered face view and keep braid, shell and harness exact as the tram continues. Crane far upward to reconnect the same inspector, complete tram and curved shoreline route.

invariants.rule: One adult identity and moving carrier remain fixed.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult identity and moving carrier remain fixed."

invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Background parallax continuously proves locomotion."

invariants.rule: Camera scale changes do not interrupt the route.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Camera scale changes do not interrupt the route."

invariants.rule: The close portrait retains motion evidence.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The close portrait retains motion evidence."

invariants.rule: The terminal aerial view reconnects person, carrier and geography.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal aerial view reconnects person, carrier and geography."
